== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The later wording removes ship-docking, which the period rulebook identifies as a capability of some ships. Its singular own-deploy-phase pull now names the Virtual Probe Droid. Capacity, permanent pilot, related site and visible inherited icons remain.
